what: Two scroll sites were AUDITED under decision D6 (the user's clause 2 chose the full sweep) and found defective, but are PARKED for the next wave: the wave's plan is approved and refuses new rows, and a team seat cannot act without a dispatched row.

findings.defect: The DAG vertical loop is uncapped: rows past the viewport are left for the HOST to clip. There is no vertical scrollbar and no onWheel, so the tail of a long subagent DAG is unreachable. Same defect class as the user's clause 4 on the team scene.
findings.recipe: Window view.lines by the existing graphY/graphYMax against measureTerminal(ui).rows; draw gutterCells(...) in the gutter column beside the drawing (frozen signature); bind onWheel through swallowWheelEvent/normalizeWheelDelta and move the window by the normalised delta; leave PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, shift-arrows and the horizontal rail untouched; add three test arms (offset 0 vs >0 yields different drawing rows, scrollbar cells differ between two offsets, a wheel event moves the window and is swallowed).

findings.defect: The plan scene is scrollable but draws NO visible scrollbar, unlike every other scrollable surface in the plane after this wave.
findings.recipe: createPlanComponent: draw gutterCells(...) in the same column width as the team scene, thumb tracking the offset, plus a test arm proving the bar cells differ between two offsets.

whyParkedNotFixed: agent_teams_plan refuses create_task on an approved plan ('stage a new one to change the team'), and both seats reported that their runtime protocol refuses work without a dispatched board row. Neither was worked around by having the captain write the code: both are ordinary delegated changes and the wave's verification law wants a writer/verifier pair.
noneOfTheEightClausesIsAffected: The user's clauses 1-8 are all delivered; these two are extra sites found by the audit sweep the user chose in clause 2.
